title: Stock Market Close: Sensex jumps 320 pts in last hour rally; Nifty ends at 25,175; Metals outperform
text:
Stock Market Highlights, Tuesday, January 27, 2026:

India’s benchmark equity indices closed higher after a volatile session on Tuesday, buoyed by improved investor sentiment following the announcement of the bilateral trade deals between India and the European Union (EU).

The deal is expected to double EU goods exports to India by 2032 by eliminating or reducing tariffs on 96.6 per cent of EU goods exports to India. Meanwhile, the EU will eliminate or reduce tariffs on 99.5 per cent of goods imported from India.

At market close, the Nifty 50 ended 0.51 per cent or 126.75 points up at 25,175.40, and the Sensex was higher by 0.39 per cent or 319.78 points at 81,857.48.

In the Sensex pack, M&M, Asian Paints, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Eternal, ITC and Maruti Suzuki India were among the top draggers, trading lower by up to 4 per cent. Axis Bank, Adani Ports, NTPC, Tech Mahindra, Tata Steel and SBI were leading the gains on the BSE, with a jump of up to 5 per cent.

Among the broader indices, Nifty Midcap 100 and Nifty Smallcap 100 ended higher by 0.59 per cent and 0.41 per cent, respectively.

On the sectoral front, the Nifty Metal index outperformed others, ending higher by 3 per cent, while the Nifty Media index closed lower by 1.4 per cent and the Nifty Auto index was down 0.9 per cent on Tuesday.
